items.difficulty_reason: 43 行、构造性论证：①仿射覆盖 + f-ample 在 U_j 上的振性（Properties proposition）给有限族 s_{j,i}；②造 H_n = f_*(F ⊗ L^{⊗n})，把 s_{j,i} 看作 V_j 上的截面，把命题归到「用有限局部自由模抬起这些截面」；③用 quasi-coherent-colimit-finite-type 取含截面的有限型子模，再用 Y 的 resolution property 给满射，拉回加 twist 得联合满射族。承重构造（截面搬运 + 抬升）都在 span 内；2 处跨章引用（Properties 两引）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-resolution-property-ample-relative (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 9462-9470

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the construction of a jointly surjective family of maps from pullbacks of finite locally free modules twisted by powers of the f-ample invertible module, using the affine cover of Y, the characterization of ampleness on the pieces, the pushforwards of the twisted target as quasi-coherent modules carrying the sections, and the resolution property of Y to lift the sections through finite type submodules (source lines 9472-9504)
